newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BEFIMMO 10-MO '96 PROFIT 333 MLN BFR. [CORRECTED 14:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: BEFIMMO 10-MO '96 PROFIT 333 MLN BFR. [CORRECTED 14:35 GMT]

text.p: Profits available for distribution 340 vs n/a
NOTE - Befimmo is a real estate fund (SICAFI) which was spun
off from Belgian property company and car park operator Bernheim
Befimmo said in a statement it would propose to shareholders
at a meeting on December 10 to pay net dividend of 98 francs a
Own funds at September 30 amounted to 562.5 million francs,
and its property portfolio was worth an estimated 6.417 billion
(Corrects headline and text to make clear that the results period is 10 months rather than six months).
